meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 安装后，Claude在每次回复前会自动调取相关的历史对话记忆，并在回复后把新见解存入记忆，从而能在后续对话中回忆起之前的内容。
howto.when: 当使用Claude Code（默认Claude提供者）启动的Agent组中，每次容器启动时激活，并在每个对话回合自动运行。

say.text: 你还记得我之前提到的那个项目细节吗？
根据我们之前的讨论，告诉我下一步怎么做。
say.note: Claude结合之前上下文给出建议

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past conversation history before each response and stores new insights after replying, enabling memory across sessions.
howto.when_en: Activated when the agent group runs with Claude Code (default Claude provider). Triggers on each container start and runs automatically for every conversation turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project details I mentioned earlier?
Based on our previous discussion, tell me what to do next.
say_en.note: Claude uses prior context to advise

say_en.text: What did we agree on before?
